newsitem.title: USA: Check Technology says delays hurt Q4 net.
newsitem.headline: Check Technology says delays hurt Q4 net.

text.p: Check Technology Corp said Monday delays by customers in completing financing arrangements were partly to blame for a 31-percent drop in net income in the fourth quarter to September 30, 1996.
Net income fell to $463,000 from $667,000 one year ago, the company said. Revenues were $5.5 million, down 21 percent from year-ago results.
The company noted the size of its transactions makes the impact of financing delays much more evident in a quarter.
Check Technology makes advanced print production systems for financial and forms printers worldwide.
